chunks: And Hammad narrated from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, that he said:

Regarding a man who marries into a people and then finds that his wife is one-eyed, and they did not make this clear to him, he said: “She is not to be returned. Marriage is only annulled on account of vitiligo, leprosy, insanity, and al-'afal.”

I said: “What do you think—if he has already consummated the marriage with her, what should be done regarding her dowry?” He said: “The dowry belongs to her because of what he made lawful from her private part, and her guardian who married her off must pay him an amount equal to what he had given to her.”

key_terms.النِّكَاحُ: marriage contract; the marital bond discussed in the ruling
key_terms.الْبَرَصِ: vitiligo; one of the defects listed as grounds for annulment
key_terms.الْجُذَامِ: leprosy; one of the defects listed as grounds for annulment
key_terms.الْجُنُونِ: insanity; one of the defects listed as grounds for annulment
key_terms.الْعَفَلِ: a genital defect impairing marital intimacy; listed among grounds for annulment
key_terms.الْمَهْرُ: dowry; the financial right of the wife discussed in the ruling
key_terms.عَوْرَاءُ: one-eyed; a physical defect mentioned here as not warranting annulment
key_terms.وَلِيُّهَا: her guardian; the one held financially responsible here

ai.seo_question: Which defects allow a marriage to be annulled in Shia fiqh, and what happens to the dowry after consummation?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling on defects affecting marriage annulment and states that one-eyedness is not among the defects for which the marriage is returned. If consummation has occurred, the wife keeps the mahr, while the guardian who arranged the marriage and failed to disclose the defect is liable to reimburse the husband.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4498 - Hammad narrated from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (as), who said regarding a man who marries into a family and finds that his wife is one-eyed, and they did not disclose this to him:
"She cannot be returned. Only marriage can be annulled due to vitiligo, leprosy, insanity, or defects of the genitalia (impairing intimacy)."

I asked: "What if he has already consummated the marriage? What happens to her dowry?"
Imam (as) replied: "The dowry is hers because he has made lawful what was private to her. Her guardian who arranged the marriage must compensate him with an amount equal to what he gave as dowry."
